page.body:
Contacts

Estimated reading: 1 minute 1063 views

Stay organised and close more deals! PropertyList’s powerful contact management system lets you centralise your client information, link properties, documents, notes, and events and create property alerts – all in one place. This ensures you have everything you need at your fingertips for a smooth and successful sales process.

Stay in the loop with complete contact history!

Each contact provides a dedicated timeline, giving you a clear view of:

  • All communication: See every email sent and received, along with any links shared etc.
  • Detailed history: Track changes made to contact information, with timestamps and usernames for complete transparency.

This comprehensive timeline empowers you to stay informed and build stronger client relationships.
